svg.title: jayanti-neu’s GitHub constellation
svg.desc: 38 public repositories arranged in a deterministic identity ring point layout. Solid lines connect projects through selected languages and topics; detected languages include secondary languages; dotted bridges join nearby groups visually and do not represent dependencies. 332 of 332 shared connections shown. Brighter paths emphasize nearby relationships; faint paths preserve the remaining selected overlaps. Star size reflects GitHub stars. Identity rings are seeded by the account name; ring points provide placement anchors for nodes. inventory-management, odin-recipes, test-deploy-ctd, css-exercises-odin, holy-tongue, household-partners, node-homework, smarttask, gcadv, recipe-finder, tikkun-haklali, freight-tracker, tier1Solo, next-tutorial, better-days-towing, Portfolio, dsem-assignment1, garrett-hidden, aed-final-project, notes-backend-mern, tehillim, node-express-course, lantern-starter, notes-frontend-mern, dsem-assignment3, dsem-assignment2, psalms-transliterated, freight-tracker-frontend, new-tehillim, clinic-app, nu-finish-site, express-hello-world, open.CRM, clinic, dsem-participation1, aed-final-proj, dsem-assignment4, dsem-assignment5.
